name: niche-indie
title: Niche: independent labels
description: Products from independent fashion labels' own Shopify stores, fetched from each store's public catalog (no third-party scrapers) and matched to your search phrases. In-stock items only, labelled by shop.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: 1 to 3 search phrases, e.g. "black satin midi dress".

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Items above this price (in the shop's currency) are dropped.

itemsPerQuery.title: Items per query
itemsPerQuery.description: Best matches kept per search phrase, across all shops.

shops.title: Shops
shops.description: Shopify store domains to search instead of the built-in list of independent labels.
